facts.fact: Galaxy Backbone's managing director and the Ministry of Communications' permanent secretary say the Government Service Portal will be hosted in the Nigerian government-owned cloud to keep data under national control, with no cloud outside Nigeria.
facts.system: Government Service Portal hosting in Nigerian cloud

systems.system: Galaxy platform (Nigerian government cloud, data centres in Abuja and Kano)

note: Hosting is a decision for a portal not yet live, so no hosted fact.
